_comment: Confirmed against the retail Steam fallout2.exe (image base 0x00400000, sfall 4.4.8 + built-in HRP). Absolute addresses are a development convenience; rva is what survives a different image base. These still need AoB signatures before distribution.

char_editor_selected.note: characterEditorSelectedItem. Verified by prediction: +3 after 3x down, returns after 3x up.

char_editor_condition_name_ptr.note: char* to current item name. Tracks ONLY the condition section (10-17); stale elsewhere.

char_editor_trait_name_ptr.note: char* to current trait name. Tracks ONLY the trait section (55-70, 94).

char_editor_trait_desc_ptr.note: char* to current trait description. Tracks ONLY the trait section.

msg_editor.note: editor.msg. Conditions, derived stat labels, UI strings (DONE/OPTIONS/CANCEL).

msg_stat.note: stat.msg. SPECIAL names 100-106, derived 107-137, descriptions from 200.

msg_perk.note: perk.msg. Not needed for chargen but resolved for free.

_dialogue_comment: Confirmed live against Klint in Arroyo: all six read as zero or -1 with no conversation on screen, and all six filled in the moment one opened. Candidates came from fallout2-ce's original-address annotations; the confirmation is this game. The option array is never cleared, only overwritten, so dlg_option_count is the only thing that says how much of it is real.

dlg_reply_text.note: What the NPC just said. Read Klint's greeting verbatim.

dlg_reply_msglist.note: Which .msg file the line came from. -2 for the engine's own [Done].

dlg_reply_msgid.note: Which line of it. Read 751:121, then 751:124 after a reply was picked.

dlg_options.note: Replies on offer. Text at +0x18, prefixed with the byte 0x95 (a bullet). Entry: msglist, msgid, reaction, proc, btn, top, text[900], bottom.

dlg_option_count.note: How many of the 30 entries are real. Load-bearing: see the comment above.

dlg_window.note: Dialogue window handle: -1 with no conversation, a GNW id with one. Cross-check only; the script's game mode is what the mod actually tests.

dlg_speaker.note: The critter being talked to. NOT yet used: the name lives behind the proto system, and the in-game script can get it for free from obj_name(dialog_obj). Recorded so the next person does not go looking.

dlg_review_entries.note: The Review screen's conversation history. Unconfirmed -- from fallout2-ce, not yet read live.

dlg_review_count.note: How many review entries. Unconfirmed, as above.
